deviations.what: c9 S6.1 *Grouped review card*: the rows. Each app row (_EntryRow, review_card.dart) is a three-line block ~110 px tall — a 20 px photo / no-photo icon and a 'from → to' title ('Cash in hand → Diesel', up to 2 lines) with an IconButton × at the right, then '−₹2,400 Money out' and the date on a second line, then the note muted on a third; the frame draws ~75 px one-line rows — a square photo thumbnail at the left, the account ('Diesel Expense A/c') over 'note · account · time' ('Isuzu, full tank · Cash · 2:02 pm'), the amount at the right, a circled × quick-reject
deviations.reason: [shared] list row (inbox entry row: thumbnail, two-line text block, trailing figure, circled ×). The app's thumbnail is an icon only (no photo preview) — 07 §9 asks for photo thumbnails
deviations.authority: 07 §9 🔒 (expandable list with photo thumbnails and per-row ✕ quick-reject); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: c9 S6.1 *Grouped review card*: the arrow in each row title ('Cash in hand → Diesel', ARB inbox.row.route '{from} → {to}') is drawn as a missing-glyph box in both captures. U+2192 is in none of the bundled faces (Mukta, Mukta Mahee, Noto Sans — checked with fontTools); the capture has no system fallback, so a phone draws it only if its own system font has the arrow
deviations.reason: [shared] type — a glyph the bundled stack does not carry (11 §4.4 names Noto Sans as the fallback, and the bundled Noto Sans subset lacks U+2192). Not cured here: the cure is an icon, a bundled glyph, or copy without the arrow, owned by the inbox lane / font owner
deviations.authority: 11 §4.4 (font stack, fallback Noto Sans); ADR 2026-10-05 §2 (the capture fails on unfaced text — this one is faced but glyph-less)
